attackers_goals: Use an account that was possibly compromised to gain access to the network.
description: A user logged in to a VPN with a new ASN.
investigative_actions: Confirm that the activity is benign (e.g. the user has switched locations and providers). Verify if the ASN is an approved ASN to authenticate from. Follow further actions done by the user.
name: First VPN access from ASN for user
